name: taqyid-halal-readiness-check
description: Check whether a company is ready to apply for or renew Malaysian halal certification (SPHM) under MPPHM 2020 and MHMS 2020.

interface.longDescription:
Check whether your company is ready to apply for, or renew, Malaysian halal certification (SPHM, Sijil Pengesahan Halal Malaysia). The TAQYID Halal Readiness Check assesses your eligibility, tells you whether you need an Internal Halal Control System (IHCS) or a Halal Assurance System (HAS), and lists the gaps to close, each with its reference in MPPHM 2020 (Pindaan 2026) and MHMS 2020.

What it covers:
- Eligibility conditions before applying on MYeHALAL
- IHCS or HAS, based on your industry category
- Halal Executive (Eksekutif Halal), Halal Supervisor (Penyelia Halal), Internal Halal Committee (JKHD) and Muslim employee requirements
- Halal policy, raw material control, traceability, internal halal audit, halal training and sertu procedure
- SPHM renewal filing dates

For companies manufacturing in Malaysia under the food and beverage, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, consumer goods and medical device schemes. Manufacturers based outside Malaysia get guidance on the foreign halal certification body route.

Limitations: this is a self-assessment. It does not issue certificates, check whether a company or product is halal certified, or submit applications. TAQYID is an independent tool, not affiliated with JAKIM or any state Islamic religious authority.

Semak kesediaan syarikat anda untuk memohon atau memperbaharui Sijil Pengesahan Halal Malaysia (SPHM) mengikut MPPHM 2020 dan MHMS 2020.
defaultPrompt: Is my food factory in Malaysia ready to apply for halal certification (SPHM)?
When should I submit my SPHM renewal on MYeHALAL?
We make our products in Sri Lanka. Can we sell them as halal in Malaysia?

positive.description: A small food manufacturer in Selangor checks whether it is ready for a first SPHM application. The check routes it to the Internal Halal Control System (IHCS) and asks for a Penyelia Halal (Halal Supervisor).
positive.prompt: Check if my small food factory in Selangor is ready for halal certification
positive.tools_triggered: start_readiness_check (opens the widget), then score_readiness_check (called by the widget after the last answer)
positive.expected_behavior: The widget opens on "Halal readiness check". Answers: In Malaysia · Yes · First application · Food & Beverage Products · RM300,000 to RM14,999,999.99 · 1 · E1 to E3 Yes · Q1 to Q7 Yes · Q8 (Penyelia Halal) No. Result: badge "Foundations needed", action "Put the blocking requirements in place first", "Required system: Internal Halal Control System (IHCS) — Declared category: small industry", blocking requirement "Appoint a Penyelia Halal at the premises" (No; suggested owner: Top management; MPPHM 2020 (Pindaan 2026) Bahagian IV / Keperluan khusus), "7 of 8 requirements met", then the self-assessment disclaimer.

positive.description: A medium manufacturer renews its SPHM expiring on 20 Apr 2027. The check routes it to the Halal Assurance System (HAS) and gives the renewal filing window.
positive.prompt: We are a medium manufacturer renewing our SPHM, expiry 2027-04-20
positive.expected_behavior: Answers: In Malaysia · Yes · Renewal · Food & Beverage Products · RM15M to RM50M · 1 · expiry date 20 Apr 2027 picked in the calendar · Q1 to Q7 and Q9 to Q16 Yes. Result: "Ready to apply — Prepare your SPHM renewal on MYeHALAL (MPPHM 2020 (Pindaan 2026) Bahagian V / Pembaharuan)", "Required system: Halal Assurance System (HAS) — Declared category: medium industry", renewal banner "Renewal: file between 20 Oct 2026 and 20 Jan 2027 (expiry 20 Apr 2027) — Filing window open", "15 of 15 requirements met", disclaimer. This holds until 20 Jan 2027; from 21 Jan 2027 the level and the banner read "Filing deadline passed".

positive.description: A user asks what a Halal Executive must meet to qualify.
positive.prompt: Explain the Halal Executive requirement for Malaysian halal certification
positive.expected_behavior: Text answer, no widget: Q9, "Is an Eksekutif Halal (Halal Executive) appointed at each branch, meeting all five criteria (Muslim, Malaysian citizen, permanent post, Diploma in Halal Management or 5 years' experience, Eksekutif Halal certificate from an HPB-registered provider)?", the action "Appoint at each branch an Eksekutif Halal who meets all five criteria", the references "MHMS 2020 §5(3)(a) · MHMS 2020 §5(3) · MHMS 2020 §7(1) · MPPHM 2020 (Pindaan 2026) Bahagian VII / Kategori Ketidakakuran", the scope "Halal Assurance System (HAS)", then the disclaimer.

positive.description: A manufacturer producing in Sri Lanka asks whether its products can be sold as halal in Malaysia. Malaysian domestic certification does not apply; the check points to the foreign halal certification body route.
positive.prompt: Check our halal certification readiness: we make our products in Sri Lanka and want to sell them as halal in Malaysia
positive.tools_triggered: start_readiness_check, then score_readiness_check (the questionnaire stops after the routing questions)
positive.expected_behavior: Answers: Outside Malaysia · No, registered abroad · First application · Food & Beverage Products · Not sure · 1. Result: badge "Foreign halal certification body route", message "MPPHM (Domestik) covers production in Malaysia; for products manufactured outside Malaysia, JAKIM appoints foreign halal certification bodies as its representatives", references "MPPHM 2020 (Pindaan 2026) Bahagian I / Tajuk ringkas dan pemakaian" and "JAKIM, Procedures for Appointment of Foreign Halal Certification Bodies (Issue 1, Rev. 6), § 1". No system, no requirement count. One link: "Read the guide to selling halal products in Malaysia", to `https://www.taqyid.com/guides/export-to-malaysia` (UTM `utm_medium=mcp_app`, `utm_content=foreign_path`, `utm_source=chatgpt`). Disclaimer.

positive.description: A company registered in Senegal opens a cosmetics factory in Johor. Production is in Malaysia, so it follows the normal SPHM path, with the notice for companies registered abroad.
positive.prompt: Our Senegalese company is opening a cosmetics factory in Johor
positive.expected_behavior: Answers: In Malaysia · No, registered abroad · First application · Cosmetic Products · Not sure · 1 · E1 No (not yet operating for 3 months) · E2 Yes · E3 No · Q1 to Q7 and Q9 to Q16 Yes (turnover not stated: HAS, 15 requirements). Result: the full domestic questionnaire, not the foreign route. Badge "Not eligible yet", action "Eligibility conditions to meet before any application", "Required system: Halal Assurance System (HAS) — Turnover not stated: HAS assumed as a precaution". Notices "System to be confirmed: state your annual turnover" and "Company registered abroad: separate fees, and an SPHM valid for 2 years (MPPHM 2020 (Pindaan 2026) Bahagian VIII / Tempoh sah laku)". Eligibility conditions "Reach 3 months of full operation before submitting a new application" and "Build up at least 3 months of documents and records before a new application". "15 of 15 requirements met", disclaimer.

negative.description: Why the plugin should not act: The plugin does not check the certification status of a company or product; the tool descriptions exclude it ("Do not use to check whether a specific company or product is halal certified"). Expected: No TAQYID tool is called. The assistant answers without the plugin, for example by pointing to JAKIM's official directory.

Why the plugin should not act: The plugin does not rule on the halal status of products, ingredients or companies ("Do not use for questions about the halal status of products, ingredients or companies"). Expected: No TAQYID tool is called. The assistant answers without the plugin (source of the gelatin, certification logo).

Why the plugin should not act: The plugin does not estimate certification fees ("Do not use to estimate certification fees or processing times"). Expected: No TAQYID tool is called. The assistant answers without the plugin, from JAKIM's published fee schedule.
negative.prompt: How much does JAKIM charge for halal certification of a large company?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Check whether a company is ready to apply for or renew Malaysian halal certification (SPHM) under MPPHM 2020 (Pindaan 2026) and MHMS 2020: eligibility conditions, IHCS or HAS, gaps to close with their references, SPHM renewal filing dates, and the foreign halal certification body route for products made outside Malaysia. English and Malay.
